verify.summary: Independent FT-005-AC-007 verification: fresh 104 unit, 5 focused and 3 browser scenarios plus mb-lint passed; local settings/reload, timing, fixed grid, late/failing cells, replay/legacy and cleanup proven. Fresh Luna co-review: no candidates. Lifecycle unchanged.

Root standalone owner closes FT-005-AC-007 after independent PASS: saved local settings, timed fullscreen gallery/late fill/replay, legacy behavior and resource cleanup verified in controlled clocks and actual browsers.

constraints: Constitution I/III: bounded accepted second-slide delta; no deployment or production probes.

Presentation owner is promo with external SpaPromoClient under client/. Extend existing display controller/preferences; localStorage read/write belongs in client/promo-display-preferences.js, no settings framework. Actual runtime storage is kiosk-origin localStorage; choose internal keys consistently with existing face-moment.promo-display-seconds and prove save/read/reload.
Use playwright cli for actual-browser UI proof; retain concrete Configuration, transition, late-cell and replay flow artifacts, without a general UI audit.

The latest successful result remains page-lifetime-only. Reuse immutable gallery; absence of gallery falls back to four-photo behavior. Extra image failure never undoes an already confirmed first result.
invariants: The first four teaser IDs, union/N, QR lifetime and first-slide ACK remain unchanged.
title: Present the optional timed Promo gallery and replay
purpose: Let the kiosk display more issued photos with local configuration while preserving first-slide confirmation and session lifetime.
success_outcome: Saved enabled settings drive timer-based photo-only 4x3 gallery and direct replay; delayed/failing additions never block first QR/ACK or timer transitions, and expiry returns to advertising.
anti_goals: No backend settings, gallery selection, persistence, auth policy, new search/session/ACK or QR lifetime changes.
No general visual audit, new client framework, jobs or polling.

forbidden_scope: Backend security, gallery selection and session/ACK persistence
Phone gallery behavior and paid flow
stop_conditions: Accepted result/media contracts do not supply the required fixed gallery.
Implementation requires a material new product decision or security policy.

verification_targets: FT-005-AC-007: controlled clocks and deferred image promises prove extras start after complete first render, unchanged first QR/ACK, timer-driven 2000ms opacity-only FIRST to SECOND without waiting, duration measured after transition or immediately with reduced-motion, 12 fixed slots with unique available photos and empty missing/failed slots, late fill and advertisement handoff. Cover disabled and absent-field legacy result, prevent stale completion after replacement/expiry/dispose, and dispose timers/object URLs.

FT-005-AC-007: use playwright cli against disposable central-origin client fixtures at logical landscape and portrait viewports. Save toggle and positive whole seconds through Configuration, reload and read through real localStorage adapter; invalid/missing duration cannot enable. Drive FIRST to photo-only full-screen 4x3 SECOND with slow/failing image and reduced-motion, expiry to advertising and click/replay directly to latest successful grid. Compare request/ACK counts and QR identity; disable and repeat legacy four-photo replay. Retain CLI transcript and decisive screenshots/trace under .tasks/TASK-143-T2-FT-005-W10/; remove disposable browser storage/profile and processes.
evidence_required: FT-005-AC-007 RED: accepted enabled configuration and controlled result cannot produce the timed second grid or direct gallery replay on baseline; GREEN: equivalent fixtures and saved settings produce exact layout/timing/late-fill/replay with unchanged first ACK/QR and correct advertising return, while disabled/legacy paths retain baseline. Decisive comparison: controlled state/timer/request trace plus actual browser layout and settings reload; artifact: focused unit/browser results and Playwright CLI transcript/screenshots under .tasks/TASK-143-T2-FT-005-W10/.
